sections.title: Common Jig Heads
description: Jigging is the practice of fishing with a jig, a type of fishing lure. A jig consists of a lead sinker with a hook molded into it and usually covered by a soft body to attract fish. Jigs are intended to create a jerky, vertical motion, as opposed to spinnerbaits which move through the water horizontally. The jig is very versatile and can be used in both salt and fresh water. Many species are attracted to the lure which has made it popular among anglers for years.

sections.title: Common Jig Heads
description: The standard round head design makes Round an extremely versatile jig head. The super sharp and very strong jig hook is very popular with pike, salmon and steelhead anglers and also has a keeper type ring behind the head to hold soft plastic baits firmly in place.

sections.title: Thorn JigHead
description: Developed by the world’s top anglers, the Thorn Jig Head proves that the devil is in the details. Small changes lead to significant improvements. The beveled weight provides a louder and clearer impact even on soft ground, while a special plastic spike holds the silicone in place, allowing you to make the retrieve in difficult conditions. The weights are painted in colors visible to fish even at great depths, significantly increasing your chances for a successful catch!
